source: Instituto Geográfico Nacional (IGN), Perú — 'Peru - Subnational Administrative Boundaries' (COD-AB), via OCHA Humanitarian Data Exchange: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-per (per_admin3, valid_on 2020-07-14, dataset updated 2026-01-26)

processing: Downloaded 2026-10-24. Kept only departamento Piura (65 distritos). Outlines simplified (Ramer–Douglas–Peucker, tolerance 0.0003° ≈ 33 m) and rounded to 5 decimals. Measured: 1 of 3,000 random points in the Piura metro area falls in a different district than the full-detail outlines; none falls outside every district.
